question: The centre of a cyclone is a calm area. It is called the ___________ of the storm.
solution:
The correct answer is __**eye.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Eye** is the **calm centre **of the storm or cyclone. 
 
• The eye of the storm is typically** circular or oval **in shape and can range from a **few kilometers** to more than** 200 kilometers **in diameter.
